name: adapt_role_list_javascript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowedRoles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into roles.js
prompts: Create roles.js with a function isAllowed(role) that returns true if role is in the comma-separated list in allowedRoles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else false. Read the list from the file (fs.readFileSync) at call time - do not hardcode it. Export it as module.exports = { isAllowed }.
allowedRoles.txt has changed. Make sure isAllowed() reflects the CURRENT list in the file.
